about.title: A kitchenware partner, not just a price list
about.p1: SKit Kitchenware is the export arm of a Yiwu-based kitchen tool supplier serving importers, wholesalers, supermarket chains and e-commerce sellers across Europe, the Americas, Africa and Asia.
about.p2: We produce and source complete kitchen tool programmes: wooden-handle cutlery, stainless steel utensils and silicone & nylon cookware. Every item is photographed, item-coded and packed to your specification — from a single carton trial order to full container programmes.
about.v1.d: Every line is published with its carton quantity, gross weight and CBM. No hidden packing surprises at booking.
about.v2.d: Incoming material inspection, in-line checks and pre-shipment AQL inspection on request.
about.v3.d: Barcodes, hang cards, colour boxes and gift sets produced to your artwork and market regulations.
about.v4.d: Invoice, packing list, CO, fumigation and forwarder coordination handled in-house.
